kernel_summary: This is a dense mixed scan/contraction kernel implementing a scalar-decay SSM with fixed H=16, D=64, S=256, and chunk size 256 over variable batch and sequence length. Its canonical recurrence is linear in sequence length, while the reference exposes parallelism through causal chunk matrices and inter-chunk state propagation; the central design tradeoff is therefore quadratic but regular chunk compute versus serial state evolution with a large 64x256 state per head. On A800, BF16 inputs with FP32 accumulation fit the numerical contract, but performance will depend on avoiding materialized expanded B/C, L, and M, preserving reuse of group-shared B/C, controlling state-tile register pressure, and specializing short, long-small-batch, and throughput-rich regimes.
